# Aikya AI

> Aikya AI is a privacy-focused language workspace for translating text and readable digital PDF documents. Its mission is One World. One Understanding.

Aikya is an independently owned SaaS product built by founder and solo developer Saurabh Choudhary. Phase 1 deliberately focuses on text translation and readable digital-PDF translation. It does not claim perfect document fidelity, invisible provider processing, or finished enterprise capabilities.
